marketing_wrapper: All 5 use the same template: saturated brand-blue sky with cloud photo backdrop, heavy bold white headline plus light subline (top ~25%), and a black iPhone frame cropped at the bottom showing ~55-60% real UI. No pop-outs; the in-frame UI looks unretouched.

typography.display: Inter-like grotesque, bold/heavy for screen titles ('Suggested for you', 'Discover New Feeds'); marketing headline is the same family at black weight
typography.body: custom: Inter or very close (single-storey details and tall x-height read as Inter, not SF)
typography.numerals: proportional, small slate counts in action row (124, 469, 5.9K)
typography.weights: bold display names, regular body, regular slate-grey handles and timestamps; semibold row titles

palette.accent_strategy: One brand blue for every action (Follow and Pin Feed pills, sent chat bubbles, selected tab underline, butterfly logo), slate-blue greys for secondary text and icons, pink only for the liked heart, semantic tinted pills for Hot (pink) and New (green).
palette.source: palette.json 01-05: #ffffff UI; #006afe/#006bfc are the marketing sky backdrop; #e9f1f7/#dde8f4 match the search field and pill fills; in-app button blue and pink read visually (slightly lighter than backdrop blue)

shape.radius_language: mixed: pill buttons and filter chips, circle avatars, ~10-12pt search fields and quote/media cards, ~18pt chat bubbles
shape.borders_shadows: hairline grey dividers between rows; 1pt grey outline on quoted post card and on unselected chips; no shadows

density: medium; 3-4 posts per viewport, ~12pt inner padding, avatar gutter left, list rows ~80-90pt tall
layout: Twitter-classic timeline: hamburger, centred butterfly, '#' feeds button; horizontal scrolling feed-tab strip (Discover, Following, Science, Catch Up, Quiet) with blue underline; posts as avatar + bold name + grey handle/time + body + 6-icon action row.
navigation: Top: hamburger drawer, logo, feeds icon; underlined text tab strip for user-chosen feeds. Bottom tab bar is cropped out of every frame (not visible). Back is a plain left arrow (not iOS chevron), suggesting cross-platform React Native chrome.
imagery_and_icons: Custom outline icon set (reply bubble, repost arrows, heart, bookmark, share arrow, ellipsis) in slate grey; filled pink heart for liked. Feed avatars are square rounded app-icon-like tiles. Emoji used inline in feed names (newspaper emoji before 'News'). Imagery = user avatars and post media.
signature_visual_move: A swipeable strip of user-chosen feed names across the top of the timeline, with one bright blue reserved for actions.
tells_present: Not native, ignores HIG (left-arrow back, Android-style chrome on iOS)

direction_fit.primary: posture-only: unified custom cross-platform system over the X/Twitter timeline grammar (feed core)
direction_fit.secondary: NEW candidate Monochrome Feed Chrome does not fit: Bluesky's chrome is white plus one owned blue, so it is closer to 'one-accent feed'
direction_fit.why: Screens show a near-copy of the classic Twitter timeline anatomy with a blue accent and Inter-like type. The differentiator visible on screen is IA (feed tabs, Pin Feed, custom feeds), which matches the text record's posture-only verdict.

notes: Marketing is the most brand-flooded part (sky blue + clouds = 'blue sky'); in-app the blue is only on actions. Hot/New pills use tinted semantic fills. Bottom tab bar never shown.
